buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic The buyer organization is an institution eligible for concessional rates of GST as notified by the

Government of India. The goods for which bids have been invited fall under classification of GST concession and the conditions for eligibility of concession are met by the institution. A certificate to this effect will be issued by Buyer to the Seller after award of the Contract. Sellers are requested to submit their bids after accounting for the Concessional rate of GST. Applicable Concessional rate of GST : 5.0 % Notification No.and date : dated 17/09/2025 3. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 4. Bidder should mandatorily submit ATC compliance state ment along with the Bid. Bids without ATC compliance statement will be summarily reje cted. Important: If a bidder wants to avail Purchase Preference, the bidder must upload a cer tificate from OEM regarding the percentage of local content and the details of location s at which the local value addition is made along with their bid failing which no purcha se preference shall be granted. Product : OH PDMS- 80000 cst, low VOC, Methanol Processed Make : Resil Chemicals Product ID : CR25-PDMS-OH(Methanol) Pack size: 5 Kg Viscosity : 60000 - 100000 cst Processing Solvent : Methanol 2. Product: Vinyl PDMS- 5000 cst, low VOC, Acetone Processed Make: Resil Chemicals Product ID: CR25-PDMS-Vinyl(Acetone) Pack size: 5 Kg Viscosity: 4000 - 8000 cst Vinyl content %: 0.3-0.5 mol% Processing Solvent: Acetone Delivery Schedule: 1. The sample shall be supplied within 30 days from the date of award of contract

2. VSSC will give sample clearance approval within 2 weeks after the receipt of sample. 3. Days of complete list of modification required in the sample: within 2 weeks 4. The remaining lot shall be supplied within 1 year from the date of sample clearance approval as per requirement from VSSC. LD is applicable for delayed delivery. Note: Sample: 1. 2 Nos of trials samples of same size 100gm is required prior to processing of bulk batch after a ward of contract. 2. The bulk supply shall be made from the same lot as the approved samples. If any variation, the entire supply shall be rejected. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ For all bid clarification queries related to this bid.
